title: Report Center
description: Generate versioned reports from an exercise, publish them, download them, or import an earlier analysis.
priorBanner: Prior analysis — imported from an earlier report. It is never mixed with the gaps generated by exercises.
emptyHint: Generate one from a finished exercise.
importHint: The original file is kept as is, labelled “prior analysis”, and never mixed with gaps generated by exercises. Supported: PDF, DOCX, Markdown.
findingsHint: Findings you record next to the original document (title, text, probable gap code, page). They can later be linked to gaps of an exercise.
